status: Concept art only. User visual acceptance and garage/gameplay implementation remain separate.
userRevision: Match the actual main player robot; the three archetypes are agile, versatile, powerful. Powerful is athletic and reinforced, not fat or extremely bulky. Front view retained.

referenceProvenance.renderer: Godot 4.7.2, front orthographic camera, original idle animation

archetypes.agile: Lean limbs, lighter plate coverage, mobile posture
archetypes.puissant: Athletic shoulders and reinforced arms with visible narrow waist

images.name: agile
images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target: the attached FRONT RENDER OF THE ACTUAL GAME CHARACTER. This exact character is the non-negotiable source of identity. Produce a faithful front-facing garage selection portrait. The user rejected prior generic robots; fidelity to THIS supplied model is paramount.
Preserve these visible specific features precisely: upright slightly irregular tall ivory capsule-shaped cyclops head; exactly ONE large bright cyan circular eye inside its dark metallic round bezel; little side hardware and antenna; worn cream/ivory plate armor with faded orange painted accents on chest panels, knees and details; dark exposed circular mechanical joints; the central circular cyan glowing chest reactor inside a dark polygonal housing; red neckerchief tied around the neck with a triangular pointed front; long narrow torn red cloth tabard hanging from the belt; backpack with a beige horizontal bedroll above shoulders; the tiny red torn pennant and small cyan optical device attached behind the head. Preserve the whole original scout/adventurer robot character, its practical worn machinery and slightly quirky charm. Do not turn it into a human, armored person, generic helmeted android or smiling toy.
Presentation: straight-on FRONT view, entire robot from antenna/pennant down to both feet, same recognizable head and face, chest visible, empty hands relaxed slightly away from hips. Soft studio light, detailed stylized 3D game-asset render matching source, mild surface wear and solid readable forms. Square image, robot about 80-84% of image height, complete silhouette with transparent margin around ALL sides. Actual transparent alpha; remove the gray background. No ground, shadow, ring, UI, frame, caption, text, numerals, weapon or new props.
Only change the body construction specified for the requested archetype. All three archetypes have approximately the SAME HEIGHT and head size. They are AGILE, VERSATILE, POWERFUL: not small/medium/fat, not levels of obesity. Keep a humanoid mechanical shape and visible articulated waist. Their equipment family, eye, chest reactor, scarf, tabard, backpack and pennant remain unmistakably identical to the supplied game model. No two-eyed round head, no barrel belly, no giant spherical shoulder pads, no chibi, no extreme oversized tank anatomy.
Requested edit: AGILE variant of THIS exact robot. Change only armor and chassis proportions to a light mobile scout. Narrower shoulder assembly with small articulated armor caps, a visibly tapered compact chest surrounding the SAME circular cyan reactor, slim exposed waist and slender upper arms/thigh mechanisms. Long light lower legs with split narrow shin guards and modest streamlined boots; trim excess forearm armor so pistons and joints show. Preserve source's angular plate shapes and orange knee accents. Energetic balanced stance, slight ready-to-move bend in knees, fully facing front. Keep solid functional construction; not skeletal, weak-looking or childlike. About 20% less body width/mass than reference, without changing the head. Original gear and red fabric remain, tabard can be slightly shorter to clear knees. Visibly agile through lean purposeful engineering.
